# PlainBTC

> Plain-English Bitcoin & crypto news for beginners

Plain-English Bitcoin and crypto news and beginner guides. Official site: https://plainbtc.com

## English

- [PlainBTC](https://plainbtc.com/): Plain-English Bitcoin and crypto news, market recaps, and beginner guides for U.S. readers. Updated November 2026.
- [About PlainBTC](https://plainbtc.com/about): What PlainBTC is: plain-English Bitcoin and crypto news for beginners, with clear disclosures and no financial advice.
- [Affiliate & referral disclosure](https://plainbtc.com/disclosure): FTC-compliant affiliate disclosure for PlainBTC: Coinbase, Gemini, and River referral links on English pages, Uphold on Spanish and Portuguese pages, and not financial advice.
- [SEC backs the CFTC on stock perpetuals and clears options on more crypto ETFs](https://plainbtc.com/articles/sec-backs-cftc-stock-perps-crypto-etf-options-nov-2026): The SEC sided with the CFTC in a court fight over stock perpetual futures and cleared Nasdaq ISE to list options on crypto ETFs that hold assets beyond bitcoin and ether.
- [Stablecoin supply shrinks at the fastest pace since 2022 as Tether's USDT loses $6.6 billion](https://plainbtc.com/articles/stablecoin-supply-shrinks-usdt-tether-nov-2026): Stablecoin supply is shrinking at its fastest pace since 2022, with Tether's USDT down $6.6 billion in 60 days. Analysts say that leaves less buying power for bitcoin.
- [Hackers hijack crypto bridge Across's website through its domain registrar; about $350,000 drained](https://plainbtc.com/articles/across-protocol-domain-hijack-phishing-nov-2026): Hackers hijacked crypto bridge Across's website through its domain registrar and drained an estimated $350,000. Across says affected users will be made whole.
- [OKX and NYSE owner ICE set Nov. 23 launch for 24/7 tokenized stock trading in the U.S.](https://plainbtc.com/articles/okxice-tokenized-stocks-launch-nov-23-2026): OKX and NYSE owner ICE will open 24/7 trading of tokenized U.S. stocks on Nov. 23, with Coinbase, Circle, Strategy and 59 Direxion ETFs among 70+ assets.
- [Bitcoin drops below $73,000 for the first time since August as bond yields jump](https://plainbtc.com/articles/bitcoin-below-73000-lowest-since-august-nov-2026): Bitcoin slid to about $72,585 on Tuesday, its lowest since Aug. 20, as Treasury yields jumped and $716 million in crypto bets were liquidated.
- [Binance warns iPhone users that an iOS flaw could expose crypto wallet seed phrases](https://plainbtc.com/articles/binance-warns-iphone-ios-flaw-wallet-keys-nov-2026): Binance says a public iOS bug, worse_query, could let malicious apps read wallet seed phrases. No thefts are reported; delete untrusted apps and update.
- [Binance blocks MEXC transfers after a U.S. Treasury order over $16.7 billion in alleged illicit flows](https://plainbtc.com/articles/binance-blocks-mexc-fincen-order-nov-2026): Binance will decline transfers to MEXC and hold deposits from it for review, after a FinCEN order that cuts MEXC off from U.S. firms on Dec. 10.
- [Goldman Sachs, Citi and other banks reportedly commit $270 million to a joint dollar stablecoin](https://plainbtc.com/articles/banks-270-million-stablecoin-project-faro-nov-2026): Big banks reportedly committed about $270 million to Project Faro, a joint dollar stablecoin aimed at the first half of 2027 that would compete with Tether and Circle.
- [Bitcoin slips toward $73,400 after a hotter-than-expected October inflation report](https://plainbtc.com/articles/bitcoin-hot-cpi-etf-outflows-nov-2026): October CPI rose 0.4%, above forecasts. Bitcoin dipped to about $73,400 as traders bet on a December Fed hike and ETF outflows continued.
- [North Korea is minting meme coins to launder the $6.4 billion Binance hack, Elliptic says](https://plainbtc.com/articles/binance-hack-north-korea-memecoin-laundering-nov-2026): Elliptic traced stolen Binance funds through six home-made meme tokens on NEAR, while about $2.85 billion of the loot stays frozen.
- [Gemini referral bonus: how it works (2026)](https://plainbtc.com/articles/gemini-referral-bonus): A plain-English reading of Gemini’s official Recruit referral terms as of 2026: the $50-each offer in listed markets, the 30-day qualifying trade, payout timing, and the markets Gemini closed in April 2026.
- [River referral bonus: how it works (2026)](https://plainbtc.com/articles/river-referral-bonus): An educational walkthrough of River’s published referral rewards — up to $100 in bitcoin each, in tiers after $100, $1,000, and $10,000 of qualifying bitcoin buys — and the 180-day rules on River’s help center.
- [What is a crypto wallet? Custodial vs. self-custody, explained for beginners](https://plainbtc.com/articles/what-is-a-crypto-wallet-custodial-vs-self-custody): A wallet doesn’t hold coins, it holds keys. Learn the difference between custodial and self-custody wallets, what a recovery phrase is, and how to start safely.
- [How much Bitcoin should a beginner buy? A plain-English guide to dollar-cost averaging](https://plainbtc.com/articles/how-much-bitcoin-should-a-beginner-buy-dca): No one can tell you the right amount, but you can pick a sensible way to decide. We explain dollar-cost averaging, test it on real price data, and show how to set up a recurring buy.
- [Is Coinbase safe for beginners? What’s protected, what isn’t, and how to lower your risk](https://plainbtc.com/articles/is-coinbase-safe-for-beginners): A plain-English safety check of Coinbase: how it stores crypto, what is and isn’t insured, what the 2025 data breach was, and a checklist to protect your account.
- [Coinbase wins a full national trust charter from the OCC: what it means](https://plainbtc.com/articles/coinbase-occ-national-trust-charter-nov-2026): The OCC approved Coinbase National Trust Company on Nov. 6, putting its institutional crypto custody under federal bank supervision. Here’s what the charter allows.
- [FinCEN and the Fed scrap the $250 Travel Rule plan—$3,000 threshold stays](https://plainbtc.com/articles/fincen-fed-withdraw-250-travel-rule-nov-2026): U.S. regulators withdrew a 2020 proposal to cut cross-border thresholds to $250 and drop crypto-specific wording. Here’s what changed—and what did not.
- [Bitcoin loses its 50-week moving average as long liquidations top $1 billion](https://plainbtc.com/articles/bitcoin-loses-50-week-moving-average-nov-2026): BTC closed below ~$75,488 after seven weeks above the line, while CoinGlass logged $1.15B in liquidations. What Galaxy’s checkpoint means next.
- [PNC Bank pilots USDC payments with Coinbase for corporate clients](https://plainbtc.com/articles/pnc-coinbase-usdc-payments-pilot-nov-2026): Eligible corporates can receive USDC on Ethereum via Coinbase Payments, with automatic 1:1 conversion into a PNC dollar deposit.
- [Bitcoin’s weekend whipsaw: $1B liquidated as Nvidia headlines hit risk assets](https://plainbtc.com/articles/bitcoin-volatility-liquidations-nov-2026): BTC briefly slipped to ~$73,761 before reclaiming $75,000. Here’s what drove the move, who got liquidated, and what traders are watching next.
- [How to buy your first Bitcoin on Coinbase (U.S. beginner guide)](https://plainbtc.com/articles/how-to-buy-first-bitcoin-coinbase): A step-by-step walkthrough: create an account, verify your identity, add a payment method, place a small first buy, and keep fees and security in mind.
- [After the midterms: ETF outflows and a tougher crypto rulebook ahead?](https://plainbtc.com/articles/us-midterms-crypto-regulation-etf-outflows): Spot bitcoin ETFs just posted their largest weekly outflow since June. Markets are pricing regulatory uncertainty as Democrats prepare to lead Congress.
- [Bitcoin ETF vs buying bitcoin: which makes sense for a U.S. beginner?](https://plainbtc.com/articles/bitcoin-etf-vs-buying-bitcoin): Spot bitcoin ETFs give price exposure inside a brokerage account. Buying bitcoin gives you the asset itself. Here is how U.S. beginners can compare custody, fees, IRAs, and taxes.
- [Coinbase fees explained: spread, Advanced maker/taker, and what a beginner actually pays](https://plainbtc.com/articles/coinbase-fees-explained): A plain-English breakdown of Coinbase fees: the variable spread on simple buys and sells, Advanced maker/taker tiers, Coinbase One, and how to compare costs on the preview screen.
- [How to cash out bitcoin on Coinbase to your bank (U.S. steps, timing, and taxes)](https://plainbtc.com/articles/how-to-cash-out-bitcoin-coinbase-to-bank): Step-by-step for U.S. users: sell bitcoin to your Coinbase cash balance, withdraw to a linked bank via ACH or instant cashout, and note the tax reporting basics.
